# CLI reference

Every command of snp 2.0.1 with its help text exactly as `snp <command> --help` prints it at `COLUMNS=100`.
The texts are rendered from the same parser tables the binary uses, so this page cannot drift from the
program. Invoked as `pre-commit` (the compat brand, see [Compatibility](../compatibility.md)) snp accepts
exactly the commands and options of pre-commit 4.7.0; the commands and options marked *snp only* exist only
under the `snp` name.

Environment variables are listed in [Environment variables](environment.md).

## Commands

| Command | Summary | In pre-commit 4.7.0 |
|---|---|---|
| [`snp`](#snp) | The top-level parser. | yes |
| [`snp autoupdate`](#snp-autoupdate) | Auto-update snp config to the latest repos' versions. | yes |
| [`snp cache`](#snp-cache) | Inspect or clean snp's cache. | *snp only* |
| [`snp cache dir`](#snp-cache-dir) | Print the cache directory. | *snp only* |
| [`snp cache size`](#snp-cache-size) | Print the size of the cache. | *snp only* |
| [`snp cache gc`](#snp-cache-gc) | Remove unused repositories and environments. | *snp only* |
| [`snp cache clean`](#snp-cache-clean) | Remove the whole cache. | *snp only* |
| [`snp clean`](#snp-clean) | Clean out snp files. | yes |
| [`snp completions`](#snp-completions) | Print a shell completion script. | *snp only* |
| [`snp config`](#snp-config) | Print the merged configuration or its JSON schema. | *snp only* |
| [`snp config dump`](#snp-config-dump) | Print the merged configuration, local overrides included. | *snp only* |
| [`snp config schema`](#snp-config-schema) | Print the JSON schema of .pre-commit-config.yaml. | *snp only* |
| [`snp doctor`](#snp-doctor) | Check snp, the hook scripts and the cache for problems. | *snp only* |
| [`snp gc`](#snp-gc) | Clean unused cached repos. | yes |
| [`snp hazmat`](#snp-hazmat) | Composable tools for rare use in hook `entry`. | yes |
| [`snp hazmat cd`](#snp-hazmat-cd) | cd to a subdir and run the command | yes |
| [`snp hazmat ignore-exit-code`](#snp-hazmat-ignore-exit-code) | run the command but ignore the exit code | yes |
| [`snp hazmat n1`](#snp-hazmat-n1) | run the command once per filename | yes |
| [`snp init-templatedir`](#snp-init-templatedir) | Install hook script in a directory intended for use with `git config init.templateDir`. | yes |
| [`snp install`](#snp-install) | Install the snp script. | yes |
| [`snp install-hooks`](#snp-install-hooks) | Install hook environments for all environments in the config file. You may find `snp install --install-hooks` more useful. | yes |
| [`snp list`](#snp-list) | List the hooks of the configuration. | *snp only* |
| [`snp migrate`](#snp-migrate) | Convert lefthook configurations or switch pre-commit-hooks to and from `repo: builtin`. | *snp only* |
| [`snp migrate lefthook`](#snp-migrate-lefthook) | Convert a lefthook configuration. | *snp only* |
| [`snp migrate builtin`](#snp-migrate-builtin) | Switch pre-commit-hooks repos to `repo: builtin`. | *snp only* |
| [`snp migrate upstream`](#snp-migrate-upstream) | Switch `repo: builtin` back to pre-commit-hooks. | *snp only* |
| [`snp migrate-config`](#snp-migrate-config) | Migrate list configuration to new map configuration. | yes |
| [`snp run`](#snp-run) | Run hooks. | yes |
| [`snp sample-config`](#snp-sample-config) | Produce a sample .pre-commit-config.yaml file | yes |
| [`snp self`](#snp-self) | Manage the snp installation. | *snp only* |
| [`snp self alias`](#snp-self-alias) | Manage the `pre-commit` alias. | *snp only* |
| [`snp self alias install`](#snp-self-alias-install) | Create a `pre-commit` alias of snp. | *snp only* |
| [`snp self alias uninstall`](#snp-self-alias-uninstall) | Remove the `pre-commit` alias. | *snp only* |
| [`snp self alias status`](#snp-self-alias-status) | Show what `pre-commit` resolves to. | *snp only* |
| [`snp self check`](#snp-self-check) | Run the built-in self-test. | *snp only* |
| [`snp try-repo`](#snp-try-repo) | Try the hooks in a repository, useful for developing new hooks. | yes |
| [`snp uninstall`](#snp-uninstall) | Uninstall the snp script. | yes |
| [`snp validate-config`](#snp-validate-config) | Validate .pre-commit-config.yaml files | yes |
| [`snp validate-manifest`](#snp-validate-manifest) | Validate .pre-commit-hooks.yaml files | yes |
| [`snp help`](#snp-help) | Show help for a specific command. | yes |
| [`snp hook-impl`](#snp-hook-impl) | Internal: called by the installed git hook scripts. | yes |

## snp

```text
usage: snp [-h] [-V]
           {autoupdate,cache,clean,completions,config,doctor,gc,hazmat,init-templatedir,install,install-hooks,list,migrate,migrate-config,run,sample-config,self,try-repo,uninstall,validate-config,validate-manifest,help,hook-impl} ...

positional arguments:
  {autoupdate,cache,clean,completions,config,doctor,gc,hazmat,init-templatedir,install,install-hooks,list,migrate,migrate-config,run,sample-config,self,try-repo,uninstall,validate-config,validate-manifest,help,hook-impl}
    autoupdate          Auto-update snp config to the latest repos' versions.
    cache               Inspect or clean snp's cache.
    clean               Clean out snp files.
    completions         Print a shell completion script.
    config              Print the merged configuration or its JSON schema.
    doctor              Check snp, the hook scripts and the cache for problems.
    gc                  Clean unused cached repos.
    hazmat              Composable tools for rare use in hook `entry`.
    init-templatedir    Install hook script in a directory intended for use with `git config
                        init.templateDir`.
    install             Install the snp script.
    install-hooks       Install hook environments for all environments in the config file. You may
                        find `snp install --install-hooks` more useful.
    list                List the hooks of the configuration.
    migrate             Convert lefthook configurations or switch pre-commit-hooks to and from
                        `repo: builtin`.
    migrate-config      Migrate list configuration to new map configuration.
    run                 Run hooks.
    sample-config       Produce a sample .pre-commit-config.yaml file
    self                Manage the snp installation.
    try-repo            Try the hooks in a repository, useful for developing new hooks.
    uninstall           Uninstall the snp script.
    validate-config     Validate .pre-commit-config.yaml files
    validate-manifest   Validate .pre-commit-hooks.yaml files
    help                Show help for a specific command.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -V, --version         show program's version number and exit
```

## snp autoupdate

Same options as `pre-commit autoupdate`.

```text
usage: snp autoupdate [-h] [--color {auto,always,never}] [-c CONFIG] [--bleeding-edge] [--freeze]
                      [--repo REPO] [-j JOBS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --color {auto,always,never}
                        Whether to use color in output. Defaults to `auto`.
  -c, --config CONFIG   Path to alternate config file
  --bleeding-edge       Update to the bleeding edge of `HEAD` instead of the latest tagged version
                        (the default behavior).
  --freeze              Store "frozen" hashes in `rev` instead of tag names
  --repo REPO           Only update this repository -- may be specified multiple times.
  -j, --jobs JOBS       Number of threads to use. (default 1).
```

## snp install

Also in pre-commit 4.7.0. *snp only* options: `--git-config-hooks`.

```text
usage: snp install [-h] [--color {auto,always,never}] [-c CONFIG] [-f] [--install-hooks]
                   [-t {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg}]
                   [--allow-missing-config] [--git-config-hooks]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --color {auto,always,never}
                        Whether to use color in output. Defaults to `auto`.
  -c, --config CONFIG   Path to alternate config file
  -f, --overwrite       Overwrite existing hooks / remove migration mode.
  --install-hooks       Whether to install hook environments for all environments in the config
                        file.
  -t, --hook-type {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg}
  --allow-missing-config
                        Whether to allow a missing `snp` configuration file or exit with a failure
                        code.
  --git-config-hooks    Install the hooks as git config entries (`hook.<name>.command`, git 2.54+)
                        instead of hook scripts.
```

## snp list

*snp only* (not accepted when snp is invoked as `pre-commit`).

```text
usage: snp list [-h] [-c CONFIG] [--json]
                [--hook-stage {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}]
                [--group GROUP] [--require-group GROUP] [--no-group GROUP]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -c, --config CONFIG   Path to alternate config file
  --json                Print JSON instead of text.
  --hook-stage {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}
                        Only list the hooks of this stage. One of commit-msg, post-checkout, post-
                        commit, post-merge, post-rewrite, pre-commit, pre-merge-commit, pre-push,
                        pre-rebase, prepare-commit-msg, manual
  --group GROUP         Run only hooks in this group; repeat to select hooks in any of the groups.
                        `@ungrouped` selects hooks without groups.
  --require-group GROUP
                        Run only hooks in this group; repeat to require every group.
  --no-group GROUP      Skip hooks in this group (repeatable; wins over --group and --require-
                        group).
```

## snp migrate lefthook

*snp only* (not accepted when snp is invoked as `pre-commit`).

```text
usage: snp migrate lefthook [-h] [--root DIR] [-c FILE] [-o FILE] [--portable] [--local]
                            [--strict] [--install] [-f]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --root DIR         Repository root (default: the current git repository).
  -c, --config FILE  lefthook configuration to convert (default: lefthook's lookup).
  -o, --output FILE  Where to write the result (default: .snp.yaml, .pre-commit-config.yaml with
                     --portable; `-` for stdout).
  --portable         Emit only keys pre-commit 4.x understands.
  --local            Also convert lefthook-local.yml into the local overlay beside the output
                     (.snp.local.yaml, .pre-commit-config.local.yaml with --portable).
  --strict           Fail (exit 2) when a feature cannot be converted faithfully.
  --install          Afterwards remove lefthook's hooks and install snp's.
  -f, --force        Overwrite an existing output file.
```

## snp run

Also in pre-commit 4.7.0. *snp only* options: `--group`, `--jobs`, `--no-fast-path`, `--no-group`, `--no-local-config`, `--require-group`, `--stdin-files`, `--summary`, `-j`.

```text
usage: snp run [-h] [--color {auto,always,never}] [-c CONFIG] [--verbose] [--all-files |
               --files [FILES ...] | --stdin-files [{nul,lines}]] [--show-diff-on-failure]
               [--fail-fast]
               [--hook-stage {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}]
               [--remote-branch REMOTE_BRANCH] [--local-branch LOCAL_BRANCH] [--from-ref FROM_REF]
               [--to-ref TO_REF] [--pre-rebase-upstream PRE_REBASE_UPSTREAM]
               [--pre-rebase-branch PRE_REBASE_BRANCH] [--commit-msg-filename COMMIT_MSG_FILENAME]
               [--prepare-commit-message-source PREPARE_COMMIT_MESSAGE_SOURCE]
               [--commit-object-name COMMIT_OBJECT_NAME] [--remote-name REMOTE_NAME]
               [--remote-url REMOTE_URL] [--checkout-type CHECKOUT_TYPE]
               [--is-squash-merge IS_SQUASH_MERGE] [--rewrite-command REWRITE_COMMAND] [-j JOBS]
               [--group GROUP] [--require-group GROUP] [--no-group GROUP] [--no-fast-path]
               [--summary] [--no-local-config]
               [hook ...]

positional arguments:
  hook                  Hook ids or aliases to run (default: every hook of the stage).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --color {auto,always,never}
                        Whether to use color in output. Defaults to `auto`.
  -c, --config CONFIG   Path to alternate config file
  --verbose, -v
  --all-files, -a       Run on all the files in the repo.
  --files [FILES ...]   Specific filenames to run hooks on.
  --stdin-files [{nul,lines}]
                        Run on the file names read from stdin: one per line (`lines`, the default)
                        or NUL-separated (`nul`).
  --show-diff-on-failure
                        When hooks fail, run `git diff` directly afterward.
  --fail-fast           Stop after the first failing hook.
  --hook-stage {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}
                        The stage during which the hook is fired. One of commit-msg, post-
                        checkout, post-commit, post-merge, post-rewrite, pre-commit, pre-merge-
                        commit, pre-push, pre-rebase, prepare-commit-msg, manual
  --remote-branch REMOTE_BRANCH
                        Remote branch ref used by `git push`.
  --local-branch LOCAL_BRANCH
                        Local branch ref used by `git push`.
  --from-ref, --source, -s FROM_REF
                        (for usage with `--to-ref`) -- this option represents the original ref in
                        a `from_ref...to_ref` diff expression. For `pre-push` hooks, this
                        represents the branch you are pushing to. For `post-checkout` hooks, this
                        represents the branch that was previously checked out.
  --to-ref, --origin, -o TO_REF
                        (for usage with `--from-ref`) -- this option represents the destination
                        ref in a `from_ref...to_ref` diff expression. For `pre-push` hooks, this
                        represents the branch being pushed. For `post-checkout` hooks, this
                        represents the branch that is now checked out.
  --pre-rebase-upstream PRE_REBASE_UPSTREAM
                        The upstream from which the series was forked.
  --pre-rebase-branch PRE_REBASE_BRANCH
                        The branch being rebased, and is not set when rebasing the current branch.
  --commit-msg-filename COMMIT_MSG_FILENAME
                        Filename to check when running during `commit-msg`
  --prepare-commit-message-source PREPARE_COMMIT_MESSAGE_SOURCE
                        Source of the commit message (typically the second argument to
                        .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg)
  --commit-object-name COMMIT_OBJECT_NAME
                        Commit object name (typically the third argument to .git/hooks/prepare-
                        commit-msg)
  --remote-name REMOTE_NAME
                        Remote name used by `git push`.
  --remote-url REMOTE_URL
                        Remote url used by `git push`.
  --checkout-type CHECKOUT_TYPE
                        Indicates whether the checkout was a branch checkout (changing branches,
                        flag=1) or a file checkout (retrieving a file from the index, flag=0).
  --is-squash-merge IS_SQUASH_MERGE
                        During a post-merge hook, indicates whether the merge was a squash merge
  --rewrite-command REWRITE_COMMAND
                        During a post-rewrite hook, specifies the command that invoked the rewrite
  -j, --jobs JOBS       Number of hooks to run in parallel (default: the number of CPUs).
  --group GROUP         Run only hooks in this group; repeat to select hooks in any of the groups.
                        `@ungrouped` selects hooks without groups.
  --require-group GROUP
                        Run only hooks in this group; repeat to require every group.
  --no-group GROUP      Skip hooks in this group (repeatable; wins over --group and --require-
                        group).
  --no-fast-path        Run pre-commit-hooks in their Python environments instead of snp's native
                        implementations.
  --summary             Print a summary of the hook results at the end.
  --no-local-config     Ignore the local override file (.pre-commit-config.local.yaml).
```

## snp try-repo

Also in pre-commit 4.7.0. *snp only* options: `--group`, `--jobs`, `--no-fast-path`, `--no-group`, `--no-local-config`, `--require-group`, `--stdin-files`, `--summary`, `-j`.

```text
usage: snp try-repo [-h] [--color {auto,always,never}] [-c CONFIG] [--ref REF] [--verbose]
                    [--all-files | --files [FILES ...] | --stdin-files [{nul,lines}]]
                    [--show-diff-on-failure] [--fail-fast]
                    [--hook-stage {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}]
                    [--remote-branch REMOTE_BRANCH] [--local-branch LOCAL_BRANCH]
                    [--from-ref FROM_REF] [--to-ref TO_REF]
                    [--pre-rebase-upstream PRE_REBASE_UPSTREAM]
                    [--pre-rebase-branch PRE_REBASE_BRANCH]
                    [--commit-msg-filename COMMIT_MSG_FILENAME]
                    [--prepare-commit-message-source PREPARE_COMMIT_MESSAGE_SOURCE]
                    [--commit-object-name COMMIT_OBJECT_NAME] [--remote-name REMOTE_NAME]
                    [--remote-url REMOTE_URL] [--checkout-type CHECKOUT_TYPE]
                    [--is-squash-merge IS_SQUASH_MERGE] [--rewrite-command REWRITE_COMMAND]
                    [-j JOBS] [--group GROUP] [--require-group GROUP] [--no-group GROUP]
                    [--no-fast-path] [--summary] [--no-local-config]
                    repo [hook ...]

positional arguments:
  repo                  Repository to source hooks from.
  hook                  Hook ids or aliases to run (default: every hook of the stage).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --color {auto,always,never}
                        Whether to use color in output. Defaults to `auto`.
  -c, --config CONFIG   Path to alternate config file
  --ref, --rev REF      Manually select a rev to run against, otherwise the `HEAD` revision will
                        be used.
  --verbose, -v
  --all-files, -a       Run on all the files in the repo.
  --files [FILES ...]   Specific filenames to run hooks on.
  --stdin-files [{nul,lines}]
                        Run on the file names read from stdin: one per line (`lines`, the default)
                        or NUL-separated (`nul`).
  --show-diff-on-failure
                        When hooks fail, run `git diff` directly afterward.
  --fail-fast           Stop after the first failing hook.
  --hook-stage {commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}
                        The stage during which the hook is fired. One of commit-msg, post-
                        checkout, post-commit, post-merge, post-rewrite, pre-commit, pre-merge-
                        commit, pre-push, pre-rebase, prepare-commit-msg, manual
  --remote-branch REMOTE_BRANCH
                        Remote branch ref used by `git push`.
  --local-branch LOCAL_BRANCH
                        Local branch ref used by `git push`.
  --from-ref, --source, -s FROM_REF
                        (for usage with `--to-ref`) -- this option represents the original ref in
                        a `from_ref...to_ref` diff expression. For `pre-push` hooks, this
                        represents the branch you are pushing to. For `post-checkout` hooks, this
                        represents the branch that was previously checked out.
  --to-ref, --origin, -o TO_REF
                        (for usage with `--from-ref`) -- this option represents the destination
                        ref in a `from_ref...to_ref` diff expression. For `pre-push` hooks, this
                        represents the branch being pushed. For `post-checkout` hooks, this
                        represents the branch that is now checked out.
  --pre-rebase-upstream PRE_REBASE_UPSTREAM
                        The upstream from which the series was forked.
  --pre-rebase-branch PRE_REBASE_BRANCH
                        The branch being rebased, and is not set when rebasing the current branch.
  --commit-msg-filename COMMIT_MSG_FILENAME
                        Filename to check when running during `commit-msg`
  --prepare-commit-message-source PREPARE_COMMIT_MESSAGE_SOURCE
                        Source of the commit message (typically the second argument to
                        .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg)
  --commit-object-name COMMIT_OBJECT_NAME
                        Commit object name (typically the third argument to .git/hooks/prepare-
                        commit-msg)
  --remote-name REMOTE_NAME
                        Remote name used by `git push`.
  --remote-url REMOTE_URL
                        Remote url used by `git push`.
  --checkout-type CHECKOUT_TYPE
                        Indicates whether the checkout was a branch checkout (changing branches,
                        flag=1) or a file checkout (retrieving a file from the index, flag=0).
  --is-squash-merge IS_SQUASH_MERGE
                        During a post-merge hook, indicates whether the merge was a squash merge
  --rewrite-command REWRITE_COMMAND
                        During a post-rewrite hook, specifies the command that invoked the rewrite
  -j, --jobs JOBS       Number of hooks to run in parallel (default: the number of CPUs).
  --group GROUP         Run only hooks in this group; repeat to select hooks in any of the groups.
                        `@ungrouped` selects hooks without groups.
  --require-group GROUP
                        Run only hooks in this group; repeat to require every group.
  --no-group GROUP      Skip hooks in this group (repeatable; wins over --group and --require-
                        group).
  --no-fast-path        Run pre-commit-hooks in their Python environments instead of snp's native
                        implementations.
  --summary             Print a summary of the hook results at the end.
  --no-local-config     Ignore the local override file (.pre-commit-config.local.yaml).
```

usage: snp validate-config [-h] [--color {auto,always,never}] [--strict] [--portable]

                        hook).
